notes.title: About Game Development as of June 2023
notes.content:
To everyone waiting for Gensokyo Night Festival

Thank you very much for supporting the game.

Back in March, we announced that Stage3 is 70% complete. However, we have encountered a new bug, and although tea_basira has been fighting it for a while now, it is very persistent and will likely take some more time to be completely resolved. At the same time, we are also working hard to improve the Stage3 map so that it will be of a satisfying quality.

We are deeply sorry for yet again being unable to provide any information on when the next update will be available. Both PLAYISM and the tea_basira are hard at work trying to make something that will meet everyone's expectations so we can announce it proudly when we're finally ready to share the good news. We apologize for the numerous delays, and we would be very thankful for your continued support and patience.

notes.title: On the Development Status as of late 2022
notes.content:
To all players waiting for Gensokyo Night Festival:

Thank you for your continuous support.
As 2022 is coming to an end,
we will take this opportunity to report on the development status of the game.

We had been especially struggling with the frequent crashes that occur on Stage2, but we have since gotten assistance from an expert who works with Unreal Engine, so we have made significant progress in identifying the issues we need to fix.
This has allowed us to finally start tackling the bugs in Stage3.

We are terribly sorry for the long wait, but please bear with us a little longer as we do our best to improve the game.

We wish everyone a very Happy New Year.
We hope to see you all again and bring better news in 2023!

notes.title: Stage 2 Adjustment Update!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Gensokyo Night Festival.

Have you already completed stage 2?
Well we have some good news!
We have pushed out an update that improves the boss fight experience!

[h3]Boss Fight Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] Yuugi has new attacks.
[*] Okuu and Orin have a new combined attack.
[/list]

[h3]Regarding Key Config[/h3]

We have taken into account all the feedback regarding the key config and have consequently overhauled it and added new features!
[b]*Apologies for the inconvenience but we ask that you reset your key config settings before continuing play.[/b]

Also we have implemented several minor bug fixes and adjustments.

We hope you enjoy the improved stage 2!

[h3]Stage 3 chibi character voting is now closed![/h3]

Thank you for all the votes!
It may take us a while to sort through all the votes as we received way more than expected, we will let you know the results as soon as we can!

notes.title: Gensokyo Night Festival Stage 2 Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Dear Gensokyo Fans,

The stage 2 update has finally gone live!
Thank you all so much for waiting, we have nothing but gratitude for your continued support for the project. We are so happy to be able to bring you this beautiful update that tea_basira has poured his heart and soul into, we are sure you'll enjoy it.

[h2]Stage 2 Update Summary[/h2]

[list]
[*] The setting is the Former Capital and there is a new ability, Flare.
[*] There is now keyboard configuratio settings as this was an extremely popular request by users.
[*] There will be a mini update coming early September which will adjust the boss balance and also add an Orin/Okuu combo attack.
[*] There will be Touhou Project Chibi characters hidden around the Stage 2 map, if you find them you can send them to Hakurei Shrine. Can you find all of them?
[/list]

[previewyoutube=Lj8NQJGKckg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]We are taking a vote for stage 3 update chibi characters![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497964/72c06fc3a69323fd18453e74fe4166f525138ea4.png[/img]

One of the chibi characters in stage 3 will be decided by popular vote, the charcater with the most votes will be hidden somewhere in the stage 3 map. Stage 3 is set to take place on Youkai Mountain and Heaven.

"How to vote: Please cast your vote in the comments section of this news post, 1 account 1 vote!
*The character doesn't have to be from the Youkai Mountain or Heaven areas."

Voting closes September 21st (JST)

We are looking forward to the results!

And with that, we hope you all enjoy playing the Gensokyo Night Festival Stage 2 update!
